orderVersionConflict.title: Order updated
orderVersionConflict.message: The order was updated by another operation. Refresh the latest state before trying again.

conflict.title: State changed
conflict.message: The current state no longer matches this operation. Review the latest state.

validation.title: Check your input
validation.message: Some fields failed validation. Correct them before submitting again.

badRequest.title: Invalid request
badRequest.message: The request contains invalid parameters or an unsupported format.

unauthorized.title: Sign in required
unauthorized.message: Your session has expired or the credentials are incorrect. Sign in again.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.message: Your account does not have permission to perform this operation.

notFound.title: Record not found
notFound.message: This record does not exist or is no longer available. Refresh the list to check.

rejected.title: Operation rejected
rejected.message: The current conditions do not meet the requirements for this operation.

internal.title: Service unavailable
internal.message: The service could not complete the request. Keep the trace ID for support.

adminNotInitialized.title: Administrator not initialized
adminNotInitialized.message: Contact an administrator to initialize the system before signing in.

admissionBlocked.title: Admission blocked
admissionBlocked.message: This release is not eligible for Shadow creation. Review the admission results.

admissionStale.title: Admission facts changed
admissionStale.message: The admission facts have changed. Reload the preview and confirm again.

admissionGuard.title: Admission guard unavailable
admissionGuard.message: A verified identity has not been bound. This operation is unavailable.

reviewConflict.title: Review updated
reviewConflict.message: Another operation updated this review. Refresh it before confirming again.

idempotencyConflict.title: Operation identity conflict
idempotencyConflict.message: This operation identifier was used for different content. Refresh and review the existing result.

network.title: Connection failed
network.message: The service could not be reached. The operation outcome may be unconfirmed.

unknown.title: Request failed
unknown.message: The request could not be completed. Keep the trace ID and contact support.

actions.refresh: Refresh the latest state and confirm again. The operation will not be replayed automatically.
actions.correct: Check your input and the operation requirements before confirming again.
actions.contact: Contact your administrator or support and provide the trace ID.
actions.checkConnection: Check your connection and the latest state. Confirm the outcome before deciding whether to retry.

networkReadMessage: Read failed. Unable to connect to the service.
networkReadAction: Check the connection and service, then reload.

login.credentials: The username or password is incorrect. Check your credentials and try again.
login.expired: Sign-in verification failed or your session is no longer valid. Sign in again to continue.
login.unavailableAccount: This account cannot sign in right now. Contact your administrator.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
login.network: Unable to connect. Check your connection and try again.
login.service: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
login.failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again or contact your administrator.

accountCommandPending.title: Account operation is unconfirmed
accountCommandPending.message: Query the original result in Accounts before starting another account operation.

accountCommandStorage.title: Operation identity could not be retained
accountCommandStorage.message: The browser could not retain the operation identity. This request has not been submitted. Restore session storage before proceeding.

accountCommandUnknown.title: Account operation outcome is unknown
accountCommandUnknown.message: The response did not match the original identity. Query the formal receipt in Accounts.

accountCommandScope.title: Signed-in user changed
accountCommandScope.message: Sign in as the original user to query the corresponding operation. Another user’s operation is not the current result.

credentialOperationUnknown.title: Credential operation awaiting confirmation
credentialOperationUnknown.message: Query the original result and retain its identity before creating or rotating credentials again.

credentialOperationIdentity.title: Credential operation identity conflict
credentialOperationIdentity.message: The successful operation has different input or its fingerprint key changed. Query its original result instead of retrying under a new identity.

feeSyncUnknown.title: Fee synchronization needs confirmation
feeSyncUnknown.message: Query the original synchronization result before creating another identity or resending.

feeSyncStorage.title: Fee synchronization identity could not be saved
feeSyncStorage.message: Synchronization has not been sent. Keep this session and check browser storage so the original operation can be recovered.

schedulerOperationPending.title: Scheduler operation pending
schedulerOperationPending.message: Look up the original operation before submitting a new run.

schedulerOperationIdentity.title: Original scheduler input conflicts
schedulerOperationIdentity.message: Keep the original ID and verify the job and parameters. Do not automatically submit a new ID.

schedulerOperationStorage.title: Cannot save scheduler operation identity
schedulerOperationStorage.message: This request has not been sent. Restore session storage before confirming the operation.

schedulerOperationUnknown.title: Scheduler operation result unconfirmed
schedulerOperationUnknown.message: Look up the original ID to confirm completion before submitting another operation.

schedulerOperationScope.title: Signed-in user changed
schedulerOperationScope.message: This scheduler operation cannot be restored under another user. Sign in as the original user to query it.

schedulerOperationVersion.title: Job control has changed
schedulerOperationVersion.message: Another operation updated this job. The original version did not change the control; reload the job before confirming again.

schedulerOperationCapability.title: Job capability is unavailable in this environment
schedulerOperationCapability.message: The required capability is not assembled or enabled. Review runtime boundaries; the scheduler switch cannot replace those prerequisites.

researchCreationUnknown.title: Creation result needs confirmation
researchCreationUnknown.message: Read the saved original result in the recovery panel before creating another object.

researchCreationStorage.title: Creation identity storage unavailable
researchCreationStorage.message: No request was sent. Restore browser storage before continuing.

researchCreationScopeChanged.title: Account changed
researchCreationScopeChanged.message: Creation was not sent. Review the saved original requests and input for the current account.
